refnamediv.refpurpose: APIs for shutting down or rebooting the system.

refsect1.title: Description
refsect1.para: io.systemd.Shutdown is a Varlink interface implemented by systemd1-related components. It can be introspected and called with varlinkctl1.
APIs for shutting down or rebooting the system.

refsect1.title: Interface Definition
refsect1.para: The following interface definition is exposed:
refsect1.programlisting:
# APIs for shutting down or rebooting the system. interface io.systemd.Shutdown
# Power off the system method PowerOff( # Controls whether interactive authentication (via polkit) shall be allowed. If unspecified defaults to false. allowInteractiveAuthentication: ?bool, # Skip active inhibitors and force the operation skipInhibitors: ?bool ) -> ()
# Reboot the system method Reboot( # Controls whether interactive authentication (via polkit) shall be allowed. If unspecified defaults to false. allowInteractiveAuthentication: ?bool, # Skip active inhibitors and force the operation skipInhibitors: ?bool ) -> ()
# Halt the system method Halt( # Controls whether interactive authentication (via polkit) shall be allowed. If unspecified defaults to false. allowInteractiveAuthentication: ?bool, # Skip active inhibitors and force the operation skipInhibitors: ?bool ) -> ()
# Reboot the system via kexec method KExec( # Controls whether interactive authentication (via polkit) shall be allowed. If unspecified defaults to false. allowInteractiveAuthentication: ?bool, # Skip active inhibitors and force the operation skipInhibitors: ?bool ) -> ()
# Reboot userspace only method SoftReboot( # Controls whether interactive authentication (via polkit) shall be allowed. If unspecified defaults to false. allowInteractiveAuthentication: ?bool, # Skip active inhibitors and force the operation skipInhibitors: ?bool ) -> ()
# Another shutdown or sleep operation is already in progress error AlreadyInProgress()
# Operation denied due to active block inhibitor error BlockedByInhibitor( # Who is holding the inhibitor who: ?string, # Why the inhibitor is held why: ?string )

refsect1.title: Examples
refsect1.para: varlinkctl introspect SERVICE io.systemd.Shutdown shows the interface definition as served by SERVICE, and varlinkctl call SERVICE io.systemd.Shutdown.PowerOff '{}' invokes its PowerOff method.
